Verifier checks the foot sensor selected by scenario configuration; regression test protects role mapping.
Workers suspend after completion; owner joins, waits for suspended states, deletes and clears handles. Fault latch stops acquisition. Native early-completion case passes.
Both IMU stops are attempted even if foot stop fails; sensor fault remains visible.
Wireless END follows final write/sync/close checks. Failure emits storage reason 1. SD END alone cannot certify persistence after a late filesystem error.
